rules.source: Loi n° 2013-015 du 21 mai 2013 portant protection des données à caractère personnel en République du Mali (modifiée par la loi n° 2017-070) — https://www.DataGuidance.com/jurisdiction/mali
rules.retrieved_snippet: Search summary: applies to processing carried out wholly or partly in Mali by State, public bodies and private persons; APDP is an independent administrative authority that sets norms, approves transfers and imposes administrative sanctions; obstructing the authority is fined 5 to 20 million FCFA (art. 65); amended by loi n° 2017-070 of 18 December 2017.
